pages_privacyPolicy_sections_introductio: Welcome to Lucas Castro's portfolio website. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the site.

Personal Data: When you contact us through the website, we may ask for personally identifiable information, such as your name and email address.
Analytics Data: We use Umami to collect information about your device and how you interact with our website.
Cookies: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and store certain information.

pages_privacyPolicy_sections_cookies_typ: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled.
This website uses Umami for usage analytics, which operates without cookies. Umami collects data anonymously and respects your browser's Do Not Track setting.
pages_privacyPolicy_sections_googleAnaly: We use Umami to analyze website usage and improve our services. Umami collects information such as how often users visit the site, what pages they visit, and what other sites they used prior to coming to this site. Umami does not use cookies and collects data anonymously. We use the information we get from Umami only to improve our website.
You can opt-out of tracking by enabling the Do Not Track setting in your browser. Umami automatically respects this setting.

The right to object to processing – You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
